evidence.quote: Differences in the molecular abundances are observed between the star forming ring and the inner circumnuclear disk.

findings_qualitative.value: HNCO delineates a rotating circumnuclear disk; HC3N and SiO concentrated inside it

evidence.quote: This disk appear to enclose the emission of HC$_3$N and SiO which suggest an stratification of the disk

claims.hypothesis: Is the HCN enhancement in AGNs due to X-ray irradiation?
claims.experiment: HCN/HCO+ abundance and ratio maps across the CND and ring
claims.result: HCN/HCO+ rises with distance from the nucleus; central X(HCN/HCO+) only marginally above ring
claims.finding: X-ray enhancement discarded; shocked material ~200 pc away favoured

evidence.quote: therefore an enhancement of HCN via X-ray from the AGN is discarded

claims.hypothesis: Why is HCN/CS lower in starbursts than AGN?
claims.experiment: Compare low-J and high-J HCN/CS with excitation modelling
claims.result: CS underabundant ~2 in AGN plus excitation differences
claims.finding: Combination of small CS underabundance and excitation effects

evidence.quote: is likely due to a real underabundance of CS of a factor of $\sim2$ together with excitation differences

claims.hypothesis: Do the dense gas tracers outline the disk structure?
claims.result: HNCO traces disk; HC3N and SiO concentrated within unresolved center

evidence.quote: HNCO, SiO and HC$_3$N are significantly enhanced

claims.hypothesis: Is CCH a tracer of star formation?
claims.experiment: Compare CCH relative abundance with FUV
claims.result: CCH abundance varies 20% below to 70% above center
claims.finding: CCH may trace obscured/early star formation

evidence.quote: it might be a good tracer of obscured star formation in the ring

why_this_method.value: Column densities used instead of intensity ratios for more accurate abundances

evidence.quote: we have estimated the column densities of each of the molecular species to have a more accurate determination of the molecular abundances

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: CS as reference species instead of HCN rejected because all ring species appear underabundant

evidence.quote: we stick to our use of HCN as it does provide abundances less biased towards the AGN position

limitations_admitted.value: Tex and source size fixed; HCN opacity uncertain in center; H13CO+ and SO at edge of detection

evidence.quote: We note that both H$^{13}$CO$^+$ and SO detections are at the edge of detection.

referee_caveats_inferred: Fixed Tex=8 K for all species and positions may bias HC3N and others
Modest resolution (~150 pc) limits disk interpretation
Single-beam source size assumption conflicts with HCN/H13CN opacity estimate
Differences are often within excitation uncertainties

reproducibility.score_reason: Public data and clear LTE assumptions, but imaging and fitting details are sparse.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Imaging and MADCUBA fitting recipes are incomplete, so numeric results are hard to redo exactly.
